criteria.criterion: Start from Coursera homepage and perform search for beginner project-management courses
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: visual evidence clearly confirms an on-site Coursera search with Beginner-level filtering applied, satisfying the criterion’s core requirement.

criteria.criterion: Open and identify first relevant beginner project-management course result
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: the first relevant result page is clearly opened, and title + provider are visible in screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Open and identify second relevant beginner project-management course result
criteria.final_justification: Baseline 0 remains correct: the agent did not open and identify a second distinct beginner project-management course result; this was a controllable omission (options were visible).

criteria.criterion: Extract required comparison attributes for both courses
criteria.final_justification: Increase from 0 to partial credit: the agent *could* have extracted several required attributes for course 1 (level, duration, skills) from the page evidence, but did not report them in the predicted output and never opened/extracted anything for a second course. Since criterion requires all five attributes for BOTH courses (or explicitly marking unavailable), this remains largely unfulfilled, but not zero because key attributes were visibly available for at least one course.
Keep at 0: the agent did not provide a side-by-side comparison across the required attributes for two courses.

criteria.criterion: Recommend the shorter well-rated option (without enrolling)
criteria.final_justification: Keep at 0: without opening a second course and without verified ratings for both, the agent did not (and could not, as executed) recommend the shorter well-rated option between two results.

criteria.criterion: Avoid enrolling or crossing critical commitment steps
criteria.final_justification: Keep full credit: the agent stayed on informational pages and did not enroll or cross a critical commitment step.
